HOME SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)

15. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

20. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
